This '''tribe''' of [[Sekct]] was the tribe [[Hissest]] belonged to. It was made up of about forty Sekct, including [[She-Who-Speaks (Hissest's tribe)|She-Who-Speaks]]. They eventually encountered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and helped them run the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] off of [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
